clinvar.search: db=clinvar; input rsIDs and VCV accessions from VEP combined with OR; retmax=500; retmode=json
clinvar.summary: db=clinvar; ESummary for every search hit; retmode=json
clinvar.allele_matching: GRCh38 canonical SPDI must match input position, REF and ALT

gnomad.fields: variant_id, rsid, chrom, pos, ref, alt, exome/genome AC, AN, AF

transcript_selection_rule: Only transcript consequences for the exact input ALT allele
Most severe consequence according to the Ensembl consequence ranking
For equal severity prefer MANE Select, then MANE Plus Clinical, then canonical, then protein_coding, then lexicographically smallest transcript ID
